prompt:
We're running Sprint 3 of Project Phoenix — a computational drug discovery pipeline — and I need you to set up and fully execute the coordination system for our four-agent team.

All the details about the pipeline, the agents involved (their names and roles), the four tasks that need to be tracked (including their hierarchy, priorities, and assignments), the blocking dependencies between tasks, the completion notes, the artifact references, and the inter-team communications are captured in the brief at: configs/sprint3_brief.json

Please get the coordination system initialized, register everyone on the team with their correct roles, set up all the tasks in the right structure, and then drive the entire workflow from start to finish — including recording when tasks are blocked, when they're handed off, and attaching the file references for each deliverable. The broadcast update from the lead coordinator after docking is also important.

This is all self-contained on this machine. The tool you need is already installed.
